messages:
nina: Heads-up 10: we're scheduling a staged promote for model v3-mixed-int4 tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Plan: 5% live, per-cust opt-in for beta accounts, plus a 3% quiet-warmup to seed KV cache. Need quick alignment on guardrails.
diego: Quick q 1 what's the main risk from shadow? latency or quality?
sara: Shadow run (80k): overall perplexity ~flat, but short-answer fidelity dropped on terse Q/A slices (delta_exact_match -1.2%). Latency p99 +40ms for some hosts. KV cold-miss rate high early.
nina: Proposed safety net: slice-level soft-stop + instant isolation for any slice hitting: 1) delta_exact_match <= -0.8% AND p<0.05 OR 2) halluc_rate increase >= +1.2% absolute OR 3) p99 latency +50ms absolute. Also: require signal for 3 consecutive 10m windows OR sample N>400.
diego: Can we add a per-customer ceiling? If a single customer sees >2% degradations across their traffic, cut their traffic to baseline.
sara: Good call. Add per-customer throttle rule: if customer_relative_mrr <= -1.5% for 2 windows, route their requests back to baseline.
opsbot: [automated] Noted: per-customer throttle enabled. Will create incident if triggered.
ina: For small slices (traffic <0.1%), avoid auto-isolation unless absolute sample N>250 to reduce false positives.
diego: What about rollback actions? Manual or automated?
sara: Hybrid: automated isolation & routing back to baseline for affected slices/customers; but full model demotion requires manual review. Automation should tag model state="isolated" and open a triage ticket with last 30min telemetry.
nina: Canary-bot please create a watchlist and start a rolling smoke monitor 30m before promote so we have baseline ramp metrics.
canary-bot: [automated] Watchlist created: model=v3-mixed-int4, live_rollout=5%, quiet_warmup=3%, slices_to_watch=[short_qna, kv_coldstart, terse_instructions], thresholds={exact_match:-0.8,halluc:+1.2,latency_p99:+50ms,per_customer_mrr:-1.5}, hysteresis={windows:3,window_size:10m,min_samples:400,small_slice_min_n:250}. Alert channels=[#eng-ml,#incidents].
diego: Also please emit a KV-cache-warmup metric to watchlist so we can correlate latency to warmup progress.
opsbot: [automated] Metric emitter enabled: kv_warmup_hit_rate.
sara: Runbook excerpt: on isolation -> 1) route slice to baseline 2) snapshot traces + top 20 failing examples 3) mark model read-only in catalog and block promotes 4) call oncall + ML lead.
nina: Schedule: promote 06:00 UTC, 4h aggressive watch, primary oncall=sara, backup=diego. I'll attach shadow CSV and short eval harness.
diego: Drop raw CSV pls. I'll run a quick cohort analysis pre-promote.
nina: Uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/shadow/v3-int4/20260325-summary.csv :paperclip:
canary-bot: [automated] Scheduled promote job for 2026-03-25T06:00:00Z, job_id=pr-1711501234, auto_isolation_enabled.
sara: Fine with plan. One more: add a quiet-dump of candidate prompts that triggered halluc classifier above threshold so human reviewers can triage quickly.
nina: Done. ok to proceed if no objections. :thumbsup:
